Definition: something stamped to pieces, i.e. a bit
BiblicalUsage: haddâm is the word for something stamped to pieces, i.e. a bit. In Daniel 2:5, the text says "ye shall be cut in pieces."
TheologicalSignificance: In haddâm I find no hidden theology; it simply means something stamped to pieces,  a bit.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace; Nebuchadnezzar's Dream of the Image
